topic: Extended VTE prophylaxis after abdominal cancer surgery
usual_baseline: Wide range. Older or unprotocolled units 14–32% compliance [2270][2583][2284]; others 61% [2231] to 82–84% [2505][2341]. Emergency cases worse: 55% vs 88% elective [2341]. After appendicectomy none had 7 days' prophylaxis [2251].
fix_that_works: Unit or Trust protocol: 14% to 91% with protocol change and education [2270]; 14.1% to 86.3%, then 92.6% after a 28-day policy [2583]. An ERAS nurse: 32% to 74% [2284]. A ward poster: 82% to 90% [2505].
fix_that_fails: A 14-day interim protocol only reached 26% compliance before the 28-day protocol [2270].
consultant_advice: Well covered in elective cancer surgery once a protocol exists. More useful to audit emergency laparotomy patients, where compliance falls, or whether patients actually complete 28 days at home.
